The app stores middleware functions in its `middleware` array and composes them into a single function using `this.compose(this.middleware)` when `app.callback()` is created.
For each incoming request, the callback creates a new context via `this.createContext(req, res)` and then calls `handleRequest` with that context and the composed middleware function.
`handleRequest` runs the composed middleware by calling `fnMiddleware(ctx)`, then on success calls `respond(ctx)` and on error forwards the error to the app’s error handler.
